reports.title: Parker Delivers Record Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results, Raises Full Year Outlook

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: The company has updated guidance for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, which now includes Filtration Group Corporation.
•Organic sales growth of 7.5% to 10.5%; acquisitions of 9%, and currency of (0.5%)
•Segment operating margin of 23.6% to 24.0%, or 27.7% to 28.1% on an adjusted basis
•EPS of $29.65 to $30.45, or $36.45 to $37.25 on an adjusted basis
